title_zh: 因设备维修改约服务时间

scenario.label_zh: 因维修中断调整服务预约
scenario.goal_zh: 核对设备维修造成的服务中断，并把自行车保养预约改到次日

context_zh: 自行车维修店临时维修车间设备，顾客来电核对原预约。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: Will the equipment repairs disrupt my bicycle service this afternoon?

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: I am afraid so. The workshop lift is out of use, and the disruption will last until closing.

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: I need the bike tomorrow evening. Could you do the service tomorrow morning instead?

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: We have a nine o'clock slot, with collection by three if the service reveals no additional work.

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: Please move my booking to nine. If anything else needs doing, call me before you start it.

sentences.speaker: Ash
sentences.text: Done. Your booking is now tomorrow at nine, and I have noted that we need your approval for any extra work.

sentences.speaker: Penny
sentences.text: Thanks. I will bring it in at nine.
